{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_03","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_03 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status='active'), balances AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.terms_code,i.discount_until,i.amount_minor AS gross,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind='payment' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key AND p.currency=i.currency),0) AS payments,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM active c WHERE c.kind='credit' AND c.invoice_id=i.event_key AND c.currency=i.currency),0) AS credits,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.currency=i.currency),0) AS holds FROM active i WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND date(i.due_date)<=date('2026-10-30')), priced AS (SELECT b.event_key,b.gross,b.payments,b.credits,b.holds,MAX(0,MAX(0,b.gross-b.payments-b.credits)-b.holds) AS unheld,t.event_key AS date(t2.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1) JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.event_key=(SELECT f2.event_key FROM active f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.currency=b.currency AND date(f2.business_date)<=date(b.business_date) ORDER BY date(f2.business_date) DESC LIMIT 1)), rounded AS (SELECT event_key,gross,payments,credits,holds,unheld,terms_key,discount_bps,fx_key,fx_num,fx_den,CAST((2*unheld*discount_factor*fx_num+10000*fx_den)/(2*10000*fx_den) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM priced WHERE fx_den>0) SELECT event_key,gross,payments,credits,holds,unheld,terms_key,discount_bps,fx_key,fx_num,fx_den,usd_cents,SUM(usd_cents) OVER () AS total_usd_cents FROM rounded WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY
